cache.error.keyNotFound: Key {key} not found (it may have expired or been deleted).
cache.error.unsupported: Driver {driver} does not support this data.
cache.error.FLUSH_DISABLED: Flushing the whole cache is disabled (OPS_CACHE_FLUSH_ENABLED=false).
cache.error.UNAVAILABLE: Cache is not connected — cannot run this action.
cache.error.BUSY: Another bulk delete is running, try again later.
cache.health.reconnecting: Lost connection to Redis, reconnecting. Cache reads count as misses.

cache.alert.HIT_RATE_LOW.title: Low hit rate
cache.alert.MISS_STORM.title: Cache miss spike
cache.alert.NAMESPACE_HIT_RATE_LOW.title: Low namespace hit rate
cache.alert.MEMORY_PRESSURE.title: Memory pressure
cache.alert.EVICTIONS.title: Redis is evicting keys
cache.alert.EVICTIONS.message: {value} keys/min evicted due to memory pressure (whole Redis server).
cache.alert.REJECTED_CONNECTIONS.title: Connections rejected
cache.alert.CONNECTIONS_HIGH.title: Connections near limit
cache.alert.EXPIRY_SPIKE.title: Many keys expiring at once
cache.alert.EXPIRY_SPIKE.message: {value} keys expire in the next 60 seconds — this may push load to the database (cache stampede).
